testedVersions: PowerShell 7.6.10, Pester 5.7.1, synthetic MicrosoftPowerBIMgmt.Profile 1.3.84 profile and documented REST v1.0 response shapes; no live execution
prerequisites: PowerShell 7.2+ in a dedicated process with MicrosoftPowerBIMgmt.Profile 1.3.84 installed separately
Interactive authorized user in the public cloud: Connect-PowerBIServiceAccount -Environment Public; authenticated TenantId must match before any reads
limits: Never tenant-exhaustive: all successful sections are Partial, including empty lists. No negative evidence or effective access.
No admin APIs, app-only sessions, My workspace, sovereign clouds or VNet gateway coverage. Live module, rights and scale validation remain pilot work.

permissions: Workspace.Read.All and access to the workspace
sections.refreshStrategy: Positive observations from a paged list of accessible workspaces.
limits: No personal workspace, tenant scan or membership expansion.

sections.refreshStrategy: List for each visible workspace; preserve readable workspaces on individual failures.
limits: No report contents or embed URLs. Paginated reports have no datasetId; external models need not be observable.

permissions: Workspace.Read.All, Dataset.Read.All and access to the dataset
sections.refreshStrategy: List models in each visible workspace.
limits: No model schema, DAX, rows or content. Read-only access can return only id and name.

permissions: Workspace.Read.All, Dataset.Read.All; write permission on the dataset for full properties
sections.refreshStrategy: Record an exact owner reference only when returned.
limits: Semantic-model ownership only; workspace administrators are not owners. A missing or unusable configuredBy never creates an identity.

permissions: Workspace.Read.All and access to enumerate the workspace's role entries
sections.refreshStrategy: Record directly returned workspace roles for linkable users and groups.
limits: Only typed user address/group GUID references; no apps, nested members, effective access or ownership inferred from roles.

sections.refreshStrategy: Enumerate gateway IDs visible to this gateway administrator.
limits: A gateway cluster is represented by its primary gateway ID, not all nodes. VNet gateways unsupported.

sections.refreshStrategy: Read configured sources per visible gateway.
limits: Only IDs and allowlisted source types. No source names, credential fields or connection details.

permissions: Workspace.Read.All, Dataset.Read.All and write permission on the dataset
sections.refreshStrategy: Record positive bindings for individually readable datasets.
limits: A source without a stable datasourceId is omitted, not identified by its connection. No queries or credentials.
